purpose: Hardware contract and provenance for an incomplete Moto QEMU model; not a flashable image or a claim of hardware identity

target.hardware_revision_meaning: Bootloader hwrev label; not a unique board identifier or a complete hardware revision specification
target.firmware_evidence: Live read-only bootloader-mode fastboot observation on 2026-10-30; device-tree analysis still refers to the older -1-3-6 firmware

live_observations.scope: Sanitized reported device properties; no raw partition reads, firmware signature validation, runtime MMIO test or new -1-3-7 DTB analysis

cpu.hardware_groups_provenance: Saved CPU implementer/part/variant/revision observations; core names identified from Arm part numbers
cpu.qemu_model_caveat: A substituted big-core CPU model must be disclosed. Renaming cortex-a78ae or cortex-a76 does not implement an identical Cortex-A78.

timer.interrupt_derivation: Arm generic timer binding order; architectural GIC PPI INTID equals the DT PPI index plus 16

memory.static_firmware_memory_reg_meaning: Bootloader-populated placeholder, not a valid RAM map

development_defaults.note: A single contiguous development bank. Neither the base nor this layout has been established as the handset's usable RAM map.

ufs.provenance: Matching firmware DTBs and saved Android boot-device property
ufs.capacity_note: The selected handset reports 128 GB; the 256 GB US retail product listing is not this unit's measured storage configuration.

display.active_panel_scope: Bootloader-reported primary panel selection; framebuffer address, stride and pixel format remain unknown

touch.provenance: Saved live sysfs/input observations and matching firmware analysis; public Motorola overlay explicitly describes GT9916P

unresolved: Actual usable RAM banks and firmware/security carve-outs

live_fastboot_report.scope: Current handset's reported SKU, PVT label, firmware, boot state, component models and primary panel; raw identifiers and full dumps excluded

matching_firmware_dtbs.scope: Selected nodes in both base DTBs from the older saved XT2517V build; not revalidated against the current -1-3-7 firmware; no runtime MMIO test

sources.public_motorola_source_scope: Android 15 source snapshot; not verified as identical to the selected Android 16 firmware
